instrument.description: One serving issuer in window 1 (F1), enforcement against an issuer that cannot serve in windows 2 and 3. ISSUER-B is registered first and ISSUER-A second, both lots bonded at deploy; after window 1 the operator drains ISSUER-B so later windows route to ISSUER-A. One issuer per window is configuration in this record, never code.

sellerFeeAsymmetry.note: The dollar route's escrow fee comes out of the seller's proceeds and the fSIU route has none. That is a seller-side difference and not a buyer's cost: price parity is a statement about what the payer pays. Sellers cannot steer which asset a quote is settled in — a seller decides only whether to sign the buyer's own request — so the asymmetry cannot bias what buyers do, and it is recorded and not equalised.
